messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "safety not known in people who have had pancreatitis"
set: ["safety not known in people who have had pancreatitis", "not enough information in humans about safety in early pregnancy", "safety and efficacy beyond 16 weeks of therapy have not been established", "heart disease is not always known about", "safety and effectiveness not established in children under 6 years of age", "not known if could harm a nursing baby", "not known whether it passes into breast milk", "some people have thoughts about suicide", "severe stomach pain may indicate pancreatitis", "not known whether it will harm an unborn baby", "some young people have thoughts about suicide", "safety and effectiveness not established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD", "conditions or medications may affect safety", "risk in people with heart disease", "risk in people with heart defect", "more likely in people with depression"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
